description: This file defines a class 'RequestHandler' implementing PSR-15 request handling strategy within the Slim Framework. It manages invoking request handler callables, optionally adding route arguments to request attributes.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Implements PSR-15 based invocation strategy for request handlers, allowing optional appending of route arguments to request attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing whether to append route arguments to request attributes.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the provided callable with the request, optionally attaching route arguments to it.
